title: eval-harness: ci hooks for prompt-regression + integrate eval metrics (quality gating)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Add first-class CI integration for eval-harness metrics and enforce prompt-set regression gating in the main CI. This PR wires eval metrics into GitHub Actions, adds a lightweight gating step that compares current run metrics to a rolling baseline, and exposes an opt-out label for experimental changes. Key changes: 1) new GH Actions job 'eval-harness-regression' which runs selected prompt-sets and uploads metrics; 2) metrics comparator utility (cli) that evaluates thresholds (delta, p95 latency, accuracy/score regressions) against the baseline and returns non-zero exit on policy violation; 3) CI hook to surface gating failures with actionable links to the failing eval run and the diffed prompt-set; 4) small refactor to eval-harness runner to support partial warm-start and deterministic seeds for CI runs; 5) docs and migration note for teams to opt-in/out. Checklist: - [x] implement GH Action job and secrets handling - [x] metrics comparator CLI + unit tests - [x] wire artifacts to actions UI with links - [x] add e2e smoke to ensure stability - [x] add rollback/opt-out label and docs Testing & Results: ran the CI job against main and this branch; initial run flagged a minor prompt-score delta on 'summarization/longform' (0.8% drop) which was investigated and traced to a prompt formatting change in examples/; subsequent run after prompt fix passed gating. This PR intentionally keeps the default thresholds conservative (fail on >2% absolute drop or >10% relative latency regression) and exposes config via .github/eval-harness.yml. Migration: teams with custom evals should add a mapping in .github/eval-harness.yml or add the 'eval-harness:skip-gate' label to PRs that are experimental. Related: ENG-4123 for baseline storage strategy; ENG-4201 for dashboarding integration.
commits: feat(eval): add GH Actions job for eval-harness regression and metrics upload

release_notes: - Add GitHub Actions job 'eval-harness-regression' to run selected prompt-sets and upload eval metrics; - Add metrics comparator CLI to enforce prompt-set quality gating in CI; - Add opt-out label 'eval-harness:skip-gate' and repo-level overrides via .github/eval-harness.yml; - Refactor eval runner for deterministic CI runs and partial warm-start;
summary: Integrates eval-harness metrics into CI, adds gating based on metric thresholds, exposes opt-out and config, and includes supporting tests and docs.
